calibration_source_metadata: Shimada et al. 2026 Plant Species Biology DOI 10.1111/1442-1984.70048
CREMV3-007.positive_detection_support: strong: multi-year full-flowering-period sensor-camera monitoring records Bombus diversus queens carrying pollinia and links recorded visits to pollinia removal/fruit development
CREMV3-007.interpretation: Positive effective-pollinator detections are biologically meaningful, but existing metadata do not support a calibrated probability of detecting the function when present. Zero sensor-camera detections therefore remain unresolved rather than F=false.

BELV3-012.positive_detection_support: strong: separate natural budbreak and adult-emergence datasets measure the two role streams
BELV3-012.interpretation: Budbreak is a biologically appropriate resource signal and is separately measured, but the available metadata do not calibrate observational false negatives for the required resource state. An unobserved or missing budbreak state therefore remains unresolved rather than F=false.

joint_decision.reason: Both retained candidates lack prospective candidate-specific observation-process validation sufficient to identify F=false.

CREMV3-007: paired or overlapping continuous/scheduled recording covering the same flowers and opportunity windows as the sensor detector
predefined effective-pollination event labels independent of fruit outcome
known-positive detection sensitivity and false-negative estimate
explicit treatment of out-of-frame, knocked-over, malfunction, and incomplete-window states
BELV3-012: repeated within-tree budbreak/resource observations across the full dependent opportunity window
independent observer or repeat-assessment agreement for the threshold defining usable new tissue
known-positive sensitivity and false-negative estimate for that resource-state rule
explicit separation of missing visits/records from confirmed pre-budbreak resource absence
